scenario.topic: Decide on a venue for the team offsite
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when picking a venue for our team offsite—cost, travel convenience, atmosphere, or available activities?

options.name: Lakeside Retreat Cabin in Lake Arrowhead
options.upside: Secluded natural setting with outdoor activities and a cozy atmosphere.
options.tradeoff: Longer drive and limited nearby dining options requiring self-catering.
options.concern: The remoteness might be inconvenient if anyone prefers urban amenities.
options.best_for: team members prioritizing nature and relaxation over convenience.

options.name: Downtown Boutique Hotel on Main Street

attrs.included_amenities: conference room, rooftop bar, walking distance to restaurants

options.upside: Easy access to nightlife and dining with professional meeting spaces.
options.tradeoff: Higher cost and less privacy due to urban setting.
options.concern: Noise from city nightlife could disrupt rest or focus.
options.best_for: those valuing convenience and social opportunities.

options.name: Historic Vineyard Estate in Napa Valley

attrs.included_amenities: wine tasting, guided vineyard tour, outdoor patio

options.upside: Unique experience with wine-related activities and scenic views.
options.tradeoff: Longest travel time and higher cost pushing budget limits.
options.concern: May not suit team members uninterested in wine or long drives.
options.best_for: those seeking a memorable, upscale experience.

options.name: Suburban Conference Center with Onsite Catering

attrs.included_amenities: AV equipment, breakout rooms, full catering service

options.upside: Cost-effective with professional facilities and no need to arrange food.
options.tradeoff: Less scenic and more utilitarian atmosphere.
options.concern: Might feel too corporate and lack team bonding vibe.
options.best_for: those prioritizing functionality and budget control.

shared_context: The team consists of exactly 3 participants.
The offsite is planned for a Friday to Saturday overnight stay in mid-September.
The total budget for venue and activities is capped at $1500.

personas.name: Zeke
personas.background: Recently took up kayaking and values quiet nature escapes to recharge after busy workweeks.
personas.private_goal: To find a venue that offers outdoor activities and a peaceful, natural setting for relaxation.

personas.name: Leo
personas.background: Prefers straightforward logistics and dislikes long travel times due to a recent back injury.
personas.private_goal: To select a convenient and low-stress venue that minimizes travel and hassle.

personas.name: Hugo
personas.background: Enjoys upscale experiences and has a passion for wine, having studied viticulture as a hobby.
personas.private_goal: To secure a memorable, high-quality venue with unique amenities that foster team bonding.
